blocks.x: Well, was there any guitar player that was getting any attention up until Christian (inaudible). (Came along?)
Well, Floyd Smith was with Andy Kirk's Crook's band. He was getting a little acclaim. But Christian came along, and with his electric guitar and that --
Well Dizzy, it was the first time anybody (inaudible). had ever been able to hear the guitar.
And that's when people became more aware of the instrument.
